enemies.name: Sarkaz Wither Vanguard
enemies.flavour_text: Elites of the Nachzehrer King's armies, adept in Originium-rich environments. They draw power from Originium dust and fight until death claims them as nutrients for their comrades.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Arts damage when inside Originium pollution.

enemies.name: Elite Sarkaz Wither Vanguard
enemies.flavour_text: Elite commanders of the Nachzehrer King's armies, adept with extreme Originium-rich environments. Originium dust sharpens their blades as they slaughter their foes, until death comes. With each commander fallen, the legion advances in great strides.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Arts damage when inside Originium pollution.

enemies.name: Caustic Originium Slug
enemies.flavour_text: Mutated Originium slugs around Londinium, altered by the rapidly changing environment. Filled with dangerous Originium particulates, their bodies explode upon death, spreading active Originium pollution.

abilities.text: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and causes Originium pollution.
Increases the strength of an Active Originium Storm when consumed by it.

enemies.name: Caustic Originium Slug α
enemies.flavour_text: Highly mutated Originium slugs around Londinium, altered by the rapidly changing environment. Filled with extremely dangerous Originium particulates, their bodies explode upon death, spreading active Originium pollution.

abilities.text: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and causes Originium pollution.
Increases the strength of an Active Originium Storm when consumed by it.

enemies.name: Profane Chimera
enemies.flavour_text: A twisted creation of the Confessarii, this bio-weapon combines multiple pure Sarkaz bloodlines. Originium dust clings to its body, spreading as it flaps its great wings while moving.

abilities.text: Continuously causes an area of Originium pollution around itself when affected by Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, and attacks deal Arts damage instead.

enemies.name: Sarkaz Altar Keeper
enemies.flavour_text: Engineer casters of the Nachzehrer legion. They set their altars on the battlefield, like nails upon a carpet woven from war. Wherever they go, the storm of suffering will soon follow.

abilities.text: Unblockable and has reduced movement speed when taking damage.
Picks up nearby Beacons if it is not carrying a Beacon, and drops them on death.

enemies.name: Sarkaz Altar Nourisher
enemies.flavour_text: Veteran engineer casters of the Nachzehrer legion whose deaths nourish the altars they carry, like leaves upon the barren soil. Their deaths bring forth the promise of suffering.

abilities.text: Unblockable and has reduced movement speed when taking damage.
Picks up nearby Beacons if it is not carrying a Beacon, and drops them on death.

enemies.name: Sudaram
enemies.flavour_text: The Sudaram is the shroud of the dead. Once gaunt from hunger, it is now nourished by the power of the Nachzehrer King. For the Nachzehrer, consumption and nourishment—greed and devotion—are just two sides of the same dreaded coin.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding units.
When inside Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding allied units and all your units inside Originium pollution or Active Originium Storms.

enemies.name: Putrefied Sudaram
enemies.flavour_text: The Putrefied Sudaram is the shroud of the fallen. Once bloated from gluttony, it now nourishes its insatiable kin. For the Nachzehrer, consumption and nourishment—greed and devotion—are just two sides of the same dreaded coin.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding units.
When inside Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding allied units and all your units inside Originium pollution or Active Originium Storms.

enemies.name: Soul Maelstrom
enemies.flavour_text: Soul fragments born of a revenant's will. Innumerable emotions intertwine within—millennia of confused memories converging into a tangible maelstrom.

enemies.name: Focused Soul Remnant
enemies.flavour_text: Soul remnant born of a revenant's will. As it absorbs the roving maelstroms, it releases turbulent witchcraft and emotions that impale enemies both in front and behind.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Arts damage. Can pick up and retain up to 3 Soul Maelstroms.
When carrying a Soul Maelstrom, expends all Soul Maelstroms to deal continuous Arts damage to the target and all your units in a line.

enemies.name: Prism Soul Remnant
enemies.flavour_text: Powerful soul remnant born of a revenant's will. As it absorbs roving maelstroms, it releases violent witchcraft and emotions that impale enemies both in front and behind.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Arts damage. Can pick up and retain up to 3 Soul Maelstroms.
When carrying a Soul Maelstrom, expends all Soul Maelstroms to deal continuous Arts damage to the target and all your units in a line.

enemies.name: Chalice of Regret
enemies.flavour_text: Soul chalice born of a revenant's will, brimming with regret unfathomable. The past, tormenting yet unchangeable, is the cruelest cut.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Shares a fraction of the damage taken by non-aerial enemies around itself.

enemies.name: Chalice of Mortality
enemies.flavour_text: Greater soul chalice born of a revenant's will, brimming with conviction immeasurable. The future, unforeseen but destined, is the ultimate verdict.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Shares a fraction of the damage taken by non-aerial enemies around itself.

enemies.name: Infused Soul Husk
enemies.flavour_text: Soul husk born of a revenant's will, imbued with the techniques of countless heroes in its memories. The heroes have all but fallen, leaving behind only indistinct silhouettes as memories.

abilities.text: Can pick up and retain up to 3 Soul Maelstroms.
When carrying a Soul Maelstrom, expends Soul Maelstrom to summon an orbiting soul orb that deals heavy Arts damage to your units that collide into it.

enemies.name: Penumbral Soul Husk
enemies.flavour_text: Powerful soul husk born of a revenant's will, imbued with the techniques of countless heroes in its memories. The heroes have all but fallen, but their silhouettes grow clearly through repeated remembrance.

abilities.text: Can pick up and retain up to 3 Soul Maelstroms.
When carrying a Soul Maelstrom, expends Soul Maelstrom to summon an orbiting soul orb that deals heavy Arts damage to your units that collide into it.

enemies.name: Kindling Revenant
enemies.flavour_text: Wraiths that immolate themselves as fuel, igniting undying flames of wrath and hatred.

abilities.text: Drains all Life Points after a long time has passed in the battle
First Form
[Soul Echo] Controls <Torrent Beam Activators> to deal continuous damage in a large area to the left. Disabled when a <Core Amplifier> is destroyed.
Allows <Core Amplifiers> to capture Soul Maelstroms. Capturing a Soul Maelstrom increases the damage of the next [Soul Echo].
Dwells in <Core Amplifiers> and cannot be attacked. Changes to second form when all <Core Amplifiers> are destroyed.
Second Form
[Raging Souls] Deals continuous damage in a large area to its right. Damage increases with the number of casts.
Casts [Raging Souls] whenever a certain amount of HP is lost.

enemies.name: Theresa
enemies.flavour_text: A life long passed, a sin long forgiven.

abilities.text: Can pick up Soul Maelstroms. Recovers HP when picking up a Soul Maelstrom.
Orbited by <Eternal Dust>, greatly reducing damage taken from their direction.
Remove all Life Points when the number of <Cocoon Cages> reaches a certain amount.
First Form

[Banish] Triggers whenever a certain amount of HP is lost, creating <Cocoon Cages> in any of the 8 surrounding tiles you have units on. (Your units on those tiles cannot attack, block, or retreat. Cocoon Cages can be attacked, but will transfer to the tiles of the units that destroy them.)
[Weave Cocoon] Triggers after quite some time into the battle, causing all <Cocoon Cages> to spread to their surroundings.
Second Form
DEF increased, RES reduced.
Orbited by more <Eternal Dust>.
[Weave Cocoon] Causes all <Cocoon Cages> to spread to their surroundings.
Casts [Weave Cocoon] whenever a certain amount of HP is lost.

enemies.name: Sarkaz Wither Bulwark
enemies.flavour_text: Veteran guards of the Nachzehrer King's legions. Martyrs who advance to certain death knowing that others will carry their blood soaked shield.

enemies.name: Sarkaz Wither Aegis
enemies.flavour_text: Elite guards of the Nachzehrer King's legions. The aegis of hatred and war is a role of ultimate protection and sacrifice.

enemies.name: Sacrilegious Chimera
enemies.flavour_text: The twisted masterpiece of the Confessarii, this bio-weapon combines multiple pure Sarkaz bloodlines. Originium dust clings to its body, which it spreads along with its endless fury wherever it treads by flapping its great wings.

abilities.text: Continuously causes an area of Originium pollution around itself when affected by Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, and attacks deal Arts damage instead.
